entries.description: First scan returned '0 format-pinned of 7,078' and I did not report it. It searched for literals like 65536, which MachLib CANNOT WRITE in a Real signature (no OfNat Real 65536) — so the scan could barely have convicted. Caught by running a firing specimen against my own scanner before quoting its zero.

Second scan reported 0 THEOREMS in files that plainly have them — the signature extractor used [^:=]*? and every binder contains a colon. THE EXAMINED-SET DENOMINATOR EXPOSED IT; the verdict column alone read as a clean 'no format param everywhere', a confident finding from a broken mechanism. Fixed, then cross-derived against a manual read that agreed.

findings.description: The format-generic property holds corpus-wide: 18 hardware/forward-error files, 223 theorem signatures, ZERO pin a format into a statement. 15 carry a free format parameter (D/s : Real or W : Nat), 3 are format-free abstractions. Four mechanisms, one discipline — format is an input to the proof, never an assumption inside it.
